ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High contrast ratio with approximately 90% of the surface area composed of high-intensity white pixels and 10% composed of low-intensity black pixels along the periphery.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large contiguous white central field; narrow black pigmentation band (approx. 5-15 pixels wide) follows the entire trailing edge and defines the distal tips.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Symmetrical V-shaped notch with a calculated pixel angle of approximately 75 degrees; depth extends approximately 25% into the vertical fluke profile.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations across both lobes; peak-to-valley pixel amplitude ranges from 4 to 18 pixels along the continuous trailing boundary.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curve extending from the median notch to the distal tips; tips exhibit an inward-tapering dark-pigmented geometry.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Low-intensity pixel clusters (dark spots) localized at the extreme distal tips and scattered sparsely on the medial surface of the right lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Faint, unaligned diagonal linear pixel disruptions visible on the inner-third of the right lobe surface.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Distinct irregular indentation/notched tissue loss on the far outer trailing edge of the left lobe lobe.
